steps.title: Build your profile
steps.body: Sign up with phone number, add your skills and location — you no need smartphone.

steps.title: Apply for jobs wey near you
steps.body: See verified jobs wey match your skills and ward, apply with one tap or for USSD.

steps.title: Work, collect your money
steps.body: Confirm attendance with employer code, collect your money that same day, every time.

faqs.q: How quick I go collect my money?
faqs.a: That same day. Once attendance confirm with employer 4-digit code, your escrow money go enter your Tally wallet, and you fit withdraw am go your bank.
No. You fit sign up, apply, and confirm shift for USSD (*347*82#) or WhatsApp. Smartphone go open the full app, but e no compulsory.
Na record wey you fit prove, wey come from jobs wey you complete, showing on time, and loans wey you pay back. Higher score dey open better jobs and real credit wey no cost too much.

faqs.q: I fit use Tally for my language?
faqs.a: Yes — the app, USSD and WhatsApp dey work for English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo. Pick your language once, e go save am for next time, for all your devices.

employer.label: Employers
employer.tagline: Hire verified, pay when e confirm

hero.emphasis: Pay only for work wey confirm.
hero.sub: Post work for few minutes, invite people wey get real track record, and put the money for escrow. Money go only comot when attendance confirm — so you no go ever pay for person wey no show.

features: Workers wey verify, wey get rating, sharp sharp
Post work and manage applicants for minutes
Escrow so you no go pay for person wey no show

steps.title: Post work, put the money
steps.body: Set the role, how many people, pay, location and shift, then put the full money for secure escrow first.

steps.title: Invite and manage
steps.body: Check verified workers wey we suggest, invite the best ones, and manage applicants from one dashboard.

steps.title: Confirm and pay
steps.body: Share the attendance code for site; escrow go comot by itself only for work wey confirm.

faqs.a: When you put the money for a job, e dey hold for dedicated escrow account — dem never send am. E dey comot only when the worker confirm attendance with your code, so you no go pay for person wey no show.

faqs.q: How I go find good workers?
faqs.a: Tally dey suggest NIN-verified workers wey get real track record and rating, wey match your job and location. You invite the ones wey you want; dem confirm.

faqs.q: How much e cost to hire?
faqs.a: Small, clear fee for every hire wey complete — we go show am before you confirm, no monthly minimum.

faqs.q: I fit post work for local language?
faqs.a: Yes. Post for the language wey you like; the hiring interface dey work for English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo, and one-tap translation of post for workers dey for our roadmap.

trader.tagline: Run your business, make am grow

hero.sub: Log your sales make you build record wey you fit prove, wey go open stock loan for you today — and get ready for full business toolkit: POS, inventory, payments and analytics, e dey come soon.

features: Log sales and build business record
Open stock loan from real history
Full POS and inventory toolkit (e dey come)

steps.title: Log your sales
steps.body: Record sales for seconds — each one dey become part of business record wey you fit prove.

steps.title: Build your history
steps.body: Steady sales dey grow your Tally Score and dey prove your business to banks and lenders.

steps.title: Open capital
steps.body: Qualify for stock advance and working capital wey match your real sales wey you fit prove.

faqs.q: Why I suppose log every sale?
faqs.a: Every sale wey you log dey become part of record wey you fit prove — and na that record dey qualify you for stock loan. The more steady your sales, the more capital you fit reach.
The full POS, inventory, and business toolkit dey for our roadmap, and we mark am Coming Soon well well. You fit start to build your sales record today so you go ready from day one.
Once your sales history qualify you, you fit collect stock advance wey match your record, wey you dey pay back as you dey sell. When you pay back on time, e dey grow your score for bigger limit.
Yes — the POS wey dey come, receipt and product listing, we dey build am multilingual from day one, for English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo.
